name: RunWay token lets anyone burn inflated sell volume from its pair
summary: RunWayERC20 (BYC) adds the full amount of every fee-taking transfer into its USDT pair to lpBurnFrequency, even when the tokens are immediately swapped back out. Its public autoBurnLiquidity() then moves lpBurnFrequency tokens from the pair to 0xdead and calls sync(). In the transaction right after the owner's launch(), the attacker bought 698,539 BYC with flash-loaned USDT, sent them back to the pair and recovered them with a second swap, then called autoBurnLiquidity(). That left the pair's BYC reserve near zero, and one sale drained its 119,950.5 USDT.

loss.notes: Exact USDT depletion of the BYC/USDT PancakeSwap pair 0x2942dfd0bf9e704348cdb16333443025ecbd8639, which fell from 119950.5 USDT to 2 wei in the exploit. Flash-loan principal and fee are circular attacker flows. The attacker netted 105363.04 USDT, of which it swapped 3000 for BNB.

ageReset.description: Owner launch() set startTradeBlock from 0 to 44534603, one transaction before the exploit in the same block. While it was 0, _transfer required a fee-whitelisted party for every pair transfer, so the non-whitelisted, fee-taking transfer that inflates lpBurnFrequency was unreachable. The flawed runtime has been unchanged since deployment.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 44534603, index 2) is a contract creation by EOA 0x14cfa851. Its child 0x9b227f90 takes a flash loan of 171883224426136996608597 USDT from 0x172fcd41. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows the steps. (1) pair.swap(0, 698538936932805869656384 BYC), paying 171833.22 USDT in the callback. (2) BYC.transfer(pair, 698538936932805869656384). The recipient is mainPair and neither side is fee-whitelisted, so _tokenTransfer adds the full amount to lpBurnFrequency. (3) USDT.skim reverts; pair.swap(0, 488977255852964108759479 BYC) returns the tokens for 2 USDT. (4) lpBurnFrequency() (0x2c3e486c) returns 698538936932805869656384. The pair's BYC balance falls from 1187385.58 (block 44534602) to 698408.32 after (3). The attacker tops it up with 130.61 BYC (and 1 wei USDT) to exactly lpBurnFrequency, then calls autoBurnLiquidity() (0x6c9e9975). That _basicTransfer(mainPair, 0xdead, 698538.94 BYC) and pair.sync() set the pair's BYC reserve to 0, so the constant-product check no longer binds. (5) BYC.transfer(pair, 488846643439123196562184) and pair.swap(277216449516799236317400 USDT, 0). The flash loan is repaid with 171901.41 USDT, and 105363.04 USDT goes to the creator contract. Identity/age: eth_getCode is empty at 44377935. keccak at 44377936 and 44534602 is the recorded hash (13155 bytes). Source-2 (index 117, contract creation by 0xe4dc205f) creates both the token and the pair. The verified source (source-4) has no upgrade path. Admin review: Etherscan txlist for the token, blocks 0..44534603, has 24 transactions: setLockup_Dynamic, setRemoveLPAddress and setPoolAddress (44378061..44378103), setManagerAddress (44378995), setPooWhiteList (44379010), 11 setFeeWhiteList calls (44533952..44534055), 6 approvals, and launch() (source-5) at 44534603 index 1. There are no setFundFee calls and no direct autoBurnLiquidity calls. eth_call startTradeBlock() (0x553193ca) returns 0 at block 44534602 and 44534603 at 44534603. Before launch every pair transfer required a fee-whitelisted party, which bypasses the lpBurnFrequency accounting. Launch therefore made the flaw reachable and is the age reset, 0 seconds before source-1 in the same block. Earliest exercise: Etherscan tokentx for USDT of the pair, blocks 0..44600000, returns 257 transfers (from block 44379303). The only one moving more than 5000 USDT out is source-1, after which the pair holds 2 wei. lpBurnFrequency() is 0 at 44534602.

Verified RunWayERC20 source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x9a69eb74060e2808344ac35bb5825051b89bbe76#code. Reproduce with Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode, chainid=56. Compiler v0.8.25+commit.b61c2a91, optimizer 10 runs. SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode (UTF-8) is 23ad3d3abbd64df1be0cc09b40e77a0384aa9992038330d44e06abd4ffc2aeba. In contracts/RunWayERC20.sol: _tokenTransfer does lpBurnFrequency += tAmount when takeFee and recipient == mainPair. autoBurnLiquidity() is public and does _basicTransfer(mainPair, DEAD, lpBurnFrequency) then ISwapPair(mainPair).sync(). _transfer requires _feeWhiteList[from] || _feeWhiteList[to] while startTradeBlock == 0, and launch() sets startTradeBlock = block.number.

Reviewed loss. USDT balanceOf(pair 0x2942dfd0bf9e704348cdb16333443025ecbd8639) is 119950500000000000000000 at block 44534602 and 2 at 44534603. Launch (index 1) moves no USDT, so the whole difference is source-1's net pair outflow (receipt Transfer logs). USDT is valued at par.
